focus: Make the next training focus visible immediately after a session.
principles: **Action before analysis.** Every metric should lead to a cue an athlete can try.
**Name the body and moment.** “Right elbow at mid-range” is more useful than “form drift.”
**Protect the next rep.** Recommend a correction that can be applied immediately.
next: Ask one athlete whether the post-session next focus is clear without explanation.
